description: Create a dynamic template: the layout and the (up to two) text fields shown with each product in catalog ads. Layout: AUTOMATIC, FILL_WIDTH, FILL_HEIGHT, FIT, HEADER, TILT. Text fields: title, price, descriptionTruncated, salePrice, availability, brand, condition, ageGroup, color, gender, productType, size, customLabel_0, customLabel_1, customLabel_2, customLabel_3, customLabel_4. Delivers nothing by itself. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_create_dynamic_template
